items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He did for me on Blue Note "Broadway" on two or three different records.

ctx.x: Stanley Turrentine, he came up from the Minton Playhouse, you know. He was doing a lot of things (inaudible) -- on Columbia.
He did for me on Blue Note "Broadway" on two or three different records. He did Broadway twice (inaudible) Minton Playhouse.
Did it once with his own group, and did it once with the girl he was married to on organ.
